question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sagacious
solution: The correct answer is **'dull'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given word 'sagacious' means having or showing good judgement and understanding. (सही निर्णय क्षमता या समझ वाला; बुद्धिमान, दूरदर्शी, विवेकशील) • ***Example***: *His actions had been** sagacious** things.* • *​***The marked option **'dull' means slow to think or understand. (सोचने या समझने में धीमा) • Therefore, from the given meaning of these words, we are clear that** 'sagacious' **and** 'boring**' are antonyms of each other. • Thus, the correct answer is** option 1.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • Let's have a look at the **meaning **of other words given in options:- • **Profound **- (of a state, quality, or emotion) very great or intense; (of a person or statement) having or showing great knowledge or insight. (गहरा; महान ज्ञान या अंतर्दृष्टि होना या दिखाना) • **Keen **- having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm. (उत्सुक) • **Intelligent **- having or showing intelligence, especially of a high level. (बुद्धिमान) 33:Tb72, The correct answer is** 'diffident'.**
